name: JonThePhotographer
bioShort: London-based DSLR + flow-arts photographer; a regular at the OXO Tower foreshore London Fire Spinners meet, Leake Street, and the wider walls / tunnel / foreshore circuit.

name: Penelope Barritt
bioShort: Editorial and stock photographer; documents the London Fire Spinners' monthly full-moon meet on the OXO Tower foreshore.

name: Tony Sellen
bioShort: London long-exposure photographer; his Long Exposure London series is a baseline reference for night-photography in the capital.

name: Sean Rodrigo
bioShort: London-based VR painter; works under Continuum VR doing live painting, training, storyboards, previs and concept art directly inside VR.

name: Gravity Sketch
bioShort: Royal College of Art spinout; cross-platform 3D modelling and creation tool for designers, used in automotive, footwear and product design.

name: Marshmallow Laser Feast
bioShort: Experiential art collective; works at the intersection of VR, AR, projection and installation. Major institutional commissions worldwide.

name: Reflex Arc
bioShort: Three-time BAFTA-nominated XR studio; longstanding digital partner of David Hockney plus immersive work for Sky, HSBC and cultural institutions.

name: Audiomotion
bioShort: Oxford-based optical motion-capture house; large-volume Vicon stage; credits across UK film, TV and games.

name: Centroid Motion Capture
bioShort: Pinewood-based optical mocap studio; film and broadcast credits including major franchise performance-capture work.

name: Imaginarium Studios
bioShort: Andy Serkis's London performance-capture house; the canonical UK address for actor-led full-body and facial capture.

name: Move AI
bioShort: Markerless multi-camera motion capture using ML pose estimation; cloud-processed full-body and facial tracking from phone video.

name: Gary J. Lucken
bioShort: British pixel artist; long-running Army of Trolls practice across game art and personal pieces, with a distinct chunky-pixel signature.

name: Chris Maltby
bioShort: London-based developer and pixel artist; creator of GB Studio, the visual development environment for Game Boy ROM creation.

name: Dan Malone
bioShort: British video game pixel artist; long career across 16-bit-era titles with a signature Mega Drive / Amiga-era palette sensibility.

name: Ian Hobson
bioShort: UK light painter; long-running practice with handheld LED torches and pixelsticks; teaches workshops on the technique.

name: David Gilliver
bioShort: Edinburgh-based light painter and night photographer; long-exposure landscape and figure work, plus workshops.

name: Apache
bioShort: XR studio based in the St Albans / London orbit; specialises in AR, VR and body-tracking work for brand and broadcast.

name: Arcade XR
bioShort: London-based immersive experience agency; AR storytelling for cultural institutions including the National Gallery, Sky, Disney and UK Parliament.

name: Visualise
bioShort: London XR agency; VR + AR + 360 + volumetric and large-scale installation work since 2011.

name: Pervasive Media Studio
bioShort: Bristol research studio at the Watershed; ~150 artists, technologists and academics exploring playful creative-technology projects.
